explanation: Cities that were given to the Levites, one of the twelve tribes of Israel, to live in and use as places of refuge.
One of the twelve tribes of Israel, chosen by God to carry out special religious duties and services in the tabernacle and later in the temple.
A person from the victim's family who was responsible for killing a murderer in case of homicide, as a form of vengeance and justice.
A safe place where someone who had committed unintentional manslaughter could seek protection from avengers of blood.
An intentional act in which a person takes another person's life with premeditation.
An accidental act in which a person takes another person's life without premeditation.
A person who performed religious ceremonies and sacrifices on behalf of the people in ancient Israel.
